annotations.title: Get AI catalyst summary for stocks

description:
TipRanks-generated catalyst summary explaining why a stock is moving.

    Each entry: {ticker, price_move, summary, sentiment, updated} where
    sentiment is 'positive' | 'neutral' | 'negative' and price_move, present
    once today's session has traded, is the stock's actual change today from
    the live quote. Use to explain today's move for a specific stock.

    Args:
        tickers: Comma-separated tickers (e.g. 'AMZN' or 'AMZN,NVDA').
name: get_stock_catalyst
